title: A Wedding in the Rain
sentences: My cousin had been planning her wedding for a Saturday in June for almost a year.
Everything was going to happen outdoors, in her parents' garden behind the house.
It rained from early in the morning until the middle of the afternoon.
Her father spent two hours putting up a tent he had borrowed from a neighbour.
Half the guests stood on wet grass in their best shoes.
My cousin refused to look upset, which impressed everybody who saw her.
The photographs are full of umbrellas.
By evening the sky had cleared completely.
People danced outside on the grass until well after midnight.
Everyone now says that it was the most memorable wedding they have ever been to.
